Saint Charbel. The hermit of Annaya.
Prayers, miracles, his story and Annaya, free and in one place. Start with nine days.
The creator of this website reports seeing Saint Charbel on December 22. This artistic rendition reflects his personal account, not independent verification or a photograph.

Saint Charbel (1828-1898) was a Maronite monk and hermit of Annaya, Lebanon, canonized in 1977. Walk through his life in the mountains of Lebanon, discover the stories of faith linked to his intercession, and enter a quieter rhythm of prayer inspired by the hermit of Annaya.

bindings.source: Be attentive to God’s grace in daily life, with patience and discernment. Trust His timing. When you receive a blessing or believe you have received a miracle, thank God and Saint Sharbel for his intercession. Let gratitude lead you to Mass, faithful prayer, and acts of love.
Lord Jesus Christ, I come before You with faith and hope. Through the intercession of Saint Sharbel, receive the intention I hold in my heart.
Take a quiet moment for your intention.
I also place before You the intentions of everyone praying with us. Comfort the suffering, strengthen the weary, bring peace to families, and draw us all closer to You.

Saint Sharbel, pray for us. Teach us to trust in God’s will and timing, to recognize His grace, and to live with grateful hearts. May every blessing lead us to love Christ more deeply and serve our neighbor more generously. Amen.
A devotional prayer written for this community.
Find a prayer for what you're carrying

Why the 22nd? This monthly devotion recalls Nouhad El Shami's reported healing, attributed in her private account to Saint Sharbel's intercession. This account is not a Church declaration. We gather in hope, entrusting every outcome to God; miracles are not limited to a date.
Walk the places of Saint Charbel
Take the online tour of Annaya, the mountain monastery where he lived as a monk and hermit and where his tomb is today, about 52 km north of Beirut.
Write a Letter to Saint Charbel
Tell your story in your own words. Continue to add your name and details before you send it. Letters stay private until a person reviews them for publication.
"And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of the testimony…"
Revelation 12:11 (Douay-Rheims), first part of the verse
Scripture puts testimony in the same sentence as the blood of the Lamb. That is how much a testimony matters, and why every Letter is read with care.
Your draft stays in this tab until you send the form. Nothing appears on the site before review.
Two ways in, whether you are gathering children or keeping a daily rosary.
Listen to Saint Charbel's story for children
A 27-page illustrated storybook for ages 5-12, with read-aloud narration on every page - a gentle first doorway into the hermit of Annaya's life of prayer.
Pray the Rosary with a daily mystery meditation
A guided mystery-by-mystery meditation with scripture, sacred artwork, and hands-free audio - today's mystery, ready when you are.
Saint Charbel is remembered for total surrender to prayer, Eucharistic devotion, fasting, humility, and a hidden life of holiness that continues to inspire millions.
Built as a complete resource with depth, beauty, and clear sourcing.
From his early years in the mountains of Lebanon to his monastic calling, priesthood, eremitical life, and eventual canonization.
Distinguishes between Church-recognized miracles in the canonization process and broader reported healings. Includes current counts and a realistic interpretation of what is formally verified.
Tracks recent public reports and shrine updates while clearly labeling what has official Vatican confirmation and what remains devotional testimony.
A practical life-rule page with prayer rhythm, silence habits, fasting framework, and concrete daily/weekly practices.
A complete step-by-step Rosary walkthrough with meditative visualization for each Hail Mary so prayer becomes contemplative, focused, and transformative.
Saint Charbel Prayers in Your Language
The prayer collection is also available in seven other languages.
Last updated: March 2, 2026. Built for marsharbel.com. Author: Please pray for the person who made this website.
